cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `DLC Support for GDK`（模块 `GDKPlatformDLC`），并同时启用正式的 Microsoft GDK 平台插件；本插件不是通用 `ChunkDownloader`。
在 `Project Settings > Platforms > GDK / Windows GDK` 填 Partner Center 产品 ID、沙盒、以及要作为附加内容的 package/chunk 标识。
用 GDK 打包流程把主包与 DLC 打成独立 `.xvc` / Microsoft Store 附加包，不要只靠 `Pak` 分块当商店 DLC。
游戏模块 `Build.cs` 依赖 `GDKPlatformDLC`，在运行时查询/挂载已安装的 GDK DLC（枚举已拥有内容、安装状态），而不是去蓝图组件列表里加一个 DLC 组件。
在 GDK 开发套件或 Retail 沙盒上验证：未购买时内容不可用，安装完成后资源可加载。
接口仍是 Experimental，不要把它当跨 Steam/EOS 的通用 DLC 层。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `DLC Support for GDK` (module `GDKPlatformDLC`) together with the shipping Microsoft GDK platform plugin; this is not generic `ChunkDownloader`.
Fill Partner Center product IDs, sandbox, and add-on package/chunk IDs under `Project Settings > Platforms > GDK / Windows GDK`.
Package the base game and DLC as separate `.xvc` / Microsoft Store add-ons through the GDK pipeline, not as Pak chunks pretending to be store DLC.
Depend on `GDKPlatformDLC` in the game `Build.cs` and query/mount installed GDK add-ons at runtime (ownership, install state). Do not add a DLC component from the Blueprint component list.
Verify on a GDK dev kit or retail sandbox: content stays unavailable until the add-on is owned and installed.
The API is Experimental; do not use it as a cross-Steam/EOS DLC layer.
note_cn: 只服务 Microsoft GDK 商店附加内容；实验接口，且必须配 GDK 打包与 Partner Center 产品。
note_en: GDK store add-ons only; experimental, and it requires GDK packaging plus Partner Center product IDs.

cn_steps: 先启用 `DMX Engine` 与 `DMX Protocol`，再启用 `DMX Control Console`（`DMXControlConsole` + `DMXControlConsoleEditor`）并重启。
内容浏览器新建 `DMX Control Console` 资产，或打开 `Window > DMX > DMX Control Console`。
从已有 `DMX Library` 的 Fixture Patch 把通道拖进控制台，生成推子/编码器（Patch，不是把控制台当灯具 Actor 放进关卡）。
确认输出端口已在 DMX Protocol 里配好，按 Play/推子把通道值送到 Art-Net 或 sACN，用灯台或网口抓包核对。
可保存多个 Console 布局资产在演播间切换；现场操作走这套推子，不要用 Sequencer 关键帧代替灯台。
`DMXControlConsoleEditor` 只进 Editor Target；Shipping 里不要链编辑器模块。
en_steps: Enable `DMX Engine` and `DMX Protocol` first, then `DMX Control Console` (`DMXControlConsole` + `DMXControlConsoleEditor`) and restart.
Create a `DMX Control Console` asset, or open `Window > DMX > DMX Control Console`.
Patch faders/encoders from Fixture Patches in an existing `DMX Library` — do not place the console as a fixture actor in the level.
With output ports configured in DMX Protocol, Play or move faders so channel values leave on Art-Net or sACN; confirm with a desk or a packet capture.
Save multiple console layout assets for stage presets. This is a live desk, not Sequencer lighting keys.
Keep `DMXControlConsoleEditor` on Editor targets only.
note_cn: 这是从 DMX Library 修补并往输出端口发 DMX 的虚拟灯台，不是灯具蓝图。
note_en: A virtual lighting desk that patches a DMX Library onto output ports, not a fixture Blueprint.

cn_steps: 同时启用 `nDisplay` / Display Cluster、`DMX Engine` 和 `DMX DisplayCluster`（`DMXDisplayCluster`、`DMXDisplayClusterLightCard`）。
打开 nDisplay 配置资产，确保场景里有 Light Card（或 nDisplay 的 Light Card Actor）。
把 Light Card 绑到 `DMX Library` 的 Fixture Patch：由 `DMXDisplayClusterLightCard` 把 DMX 通道映射到卡片颜色、强度、变换。
用真实灯台或 Control Console 改通道，在 nDisplay 集群视口看 Light Card 是否同步，而不是只在编辑器主视口看普通灯。
集群节点都要加载同一套 DMX 端口与 Library；只在主编辑器改 DMX、从节点未同步端口会导致墙体灯卡不亮。
这是 DMX↔nDisplay 桥，不要把它当独立像素映射编辑器（那是 `DMX Pixel Mapping`）。
en_steps: Enable `nDisplay` / Display Cluster, `DMX Engine`, and `DMX DisplayCluster` (`DMXDisplayCluster`, `DMXDisplayClusterLightCard`).
Open the nDisplay config and confirm Light Cards exist in the cluster scene.
Bind those cards to `DMX Library` Fixture Patches so `DMXDisplayClusterLightCard` maps DMX channels onto card color, intensity, and transform.
Drive channels from a desk or Control Console and watch Light Cards on the nDisplay cluster view, not only a regular editor light.
Every cluster node needs the same DMX ports and Library; editing ports only on the primary leaves wall cards dark on inner nodes.
This is the DMX↔nDisplay bridge, not the pixel-mapping editor (`DMX Pixel Mapping`).
note_cn: 用来让灯台 DMX 驱动 nDisplay Light Card，离开集群配置没有独立面板可玩。
note_en: Drives nDisplay Light Cards from DMX; there is no useful standalone panel without a cluster config.

cn_steps: 启用 `DMX Engine`（`DMXRuntime`、`DMXEditor`、`DMXBlueprintGraph`）；协议进出还要启用 `DMX Protocol`。
内容浏览器右键新建 `DMX Library`，在其中创建 Fixture Type、Fixture Patch 和 Controller（Universe/地址）。
从 `Window > DMX` 打开 Library 编辑器核对 Patch 表；关卡里放置灯具 Actor 后，在 Details 指定 Library + Patch。
蓝图用 `DMXRuntime` 节点读写属性（如 `Get DMX Fixture Attributes` / `Set DMX Attribute`），走 `DMXBlueprintGraph`，不要手写原始 512 通道除非必要。
PIE 或 On-Air 时看灯具 Actor 的光束/颜色是否跟输入端口或控制台一致。
游戏模块只依赖 `DMXRuntime`；`DMXEditor` 与图节点模块不要写进 Game Target。
en_steps: Enable `DMX Engine` (`DMXRuntime`, `DMXEditor`, `DMXBlueprintGraph`); also enable `DMX Protocol` if you need wire I/O.
Create a `DMX Library` asset and author Fixture Types, Fixture Patches, and Controllers (universe/address).
Open the Library editor from `Window > DMX`, then place fixture actors and assign Library + Patch in Details.
Read/write attributes from Blueprint via `DMXRuntime` nodes (`Get DMX Fixture Attributes` / `Set DMX Attribute`) from `DMXBlueprintGraph`; avoid raw 512-slot buffers unless you must.
In PIE or on-air, confirm fixture beams/color match the input port or console.
Game modules depend on `DMXRuntime` only; keep `DMXEditor` off Game targets.
note_cn: DMX 资产与运行时核心：Library/Patch/属性；端口协议在 `DMX Protocol`，灯具网格在 `DMX Fixtures`。
note_en: Core Library/Patch/attribute runtime; wire ports live in `DMX Protocol`, fixture meshes in `DMX Fixtures`.

cn_steps: 启用 `DMX Engine` 后再启用 `DMX Fixtures`（模块 `DMXFixtures`），并在内容浏览器打开该插件的 Content。
把插件自带的灯具蓝图（如 Moving Head、Point Light、Par 等 `DMXFixtureActor` 子类）拖进舞台关卡。
在 Actor Details 指定 `DMX Library` 与 Fixture Patch，让属性（Pan/Tilt/Dimmer/Color）驱动组件灯光与骨骼。
用 Control Console 或外部灯台改通道，视口里确认头灯转动和亮度，而不是只看通道监视器。
自定义灯具应继承这些蓝图或实现灯具接口，不要从零复制一份不接 Patch 的静态网格。
可进包装；没有 Library Patch 时灯具只是普通网格，不会响应 DMX。
en_steps: Enable `DMX Engine`, then `DMX Fixtures` (module `DMXFixtures`), and show the plugin Content folder.
Drop stock fixture Blueprints (Moving Head, Point Light, Par, and other `DMXFixtureActor` subclasses) into the stage level.
In Details, assign a `DMX Library` Fixture Patch so attributes (Pan/Tilt/Dimmer/Color) drive lights and bones.
Move channels from the Control Console or an external desk and confirm head motion and intensity in the viewport, not only a channel monitor.
Subclass these Blueprints or the fixture interface for custom units; do not duplicate a static mesh that never binds a Patch.
Shippable; without a Library Patch the actor is just a mesh and will not respond to DMX.
note_cn: 提供可放置的灯具蓝图；通道语义仍由 DMX Library 的 Fixture Type 定义。
note_en: Placeable fixture Blueprints; channel meaning still comes from the DMX Library Fixture Type.

cn_steps: 启用 `DMX Engine` 与 `DMX GDTF`（`DMXGDTF`、`DMXZip`；测试模块 `DMXGDTFTests` 不要进游戏）。
准备厂商 `.gdtf`（本质是 zip：模型、DMX 模式、几何），在 `DMX Library` 里用 GDTF 导入而不是手填几百个通道。
`DMXZip` 负责解开 GDTF 容器；导入后检查 Fixture Type 的模式、几何和通道集是否齐全。
把导入的 Type 做成 Fixture Patch，挂到 `DMX Fixtures` Actor 或 Pixel Mapping 单元格。
需要回归时在 `Session Frontend > Automation` 跑 `DMXGDTFTests`，不要把测试模块写进 `Build.cs`。
这是 GDTF 类型实现，不是灯台，也不是 Art-Net 端口配置。
en_steps: Enable `DMX Engine` and `DMX GDTF` (`DMXGDTF`, `DMXZip`; leave `DMXGDTFTests` out of the game).
Take a vendor `.gdtf` (a zip of models, DMX modes, geometry) and import it into a `DMX Library` instead of hand-authoring hundreds of channels.
`DMXZip` unpacks the GDTF container; after import, check modes, geometry, and channel sets on the Fixture Type.
Create a Fixture Patch from that type and bind it to a `DMX Fixtures` actor or Pixel Mapping cells.
Run `DMXGDTFTests` from `Session Frontend > Automation` when you need a regression; do not add the test module to `Build.cs`.
This is the GDTF type implementation, not a lighting desk or Art-Net port UI.
note_cn: 把 GDTF 标准解成 UE 的 Fixture Type；zip 解包走 `DMXZip`。
note_en: Maps the GDTF standard onto UE Fixture Types; `DMXZip` unpacks the container.

cn_steps: 启用 `DMX Modular Features`（唯一模块 `DMXFixtureActorInterface`）。它只提供灯具 Actor 接口，没有灯具网格或控制台 UI。
在自定义游戏/功能模块的 `Build.cs` 依赖 `DMXFixtureActorInterface`，让灯具类实现 `IDMXFixtureActorInterface`（或引擎暴露的同名 Fixture Actor 接口）。
把该 Actor 注册为 Modular Feature，使 `DMX Engine` / Pixel Mapping 能按接口枚举场景灯具，而不必依赖 `DMXFixtures` 插件内容。
实现接口要求的 Patch 绑定与属性应用函数；PIE 里用 Library 改通道，确认自定义 Actor 有响应。
不要在 `Window > DMX` 里找本插件的独立面板——没有。
可与 `DMX Fixtures` 并存：商店灯具走官方蓝图，项目自研灯具走此接口。
en_steps: Enable `DMX Modular Features` (module `DMXFixtureActorInterface`). It is the fixture-actor interface only — no meshes or console UI.
Depend on `DMXFixtureActorInterface` in your game/feature `Build.cs` and implement `IDMXFixtureActorInterface` (the fixture actor interface) on your class.
Register the actor as a Modular Feature so `DMX Engine` / Pixel Mapping can enumerate fixtures without depending on `DMXFixtures` content.
Implement patch binding and attribute application; change Library channels in PIE and confirm the custom actor responds.
Do not look for a `Window > DMX` panel owned by this plugin — there is none.
Can coexist with `DMX Fixtures`: stock Blueprints vs. project-owned fixtures on this interface.
note_cn: 给自研灯具用的 Modular Feature 接口，不是又一套灯具资产包。
note_en: A Modular Feature interface for custom fixtures, not another fixture content pack.

cn_steps: 启用 `DMX Engine`、`DMX Protocol` 和 `DMX Pixel Mapping`（`DMXPixelMappingRuntime` / `DMXPixelMappingRenderer`；编辑器为 `DMXPixelMappingEditor`）。
新建 `DMX Pixel Mapping` 资产，双击打开像素映射编辑器（不是普通材质编辑器）。
添加 Renderer（场景捕获、纹理或材质输出），再添加对应 Fixture Patch 的像素组，把单元格铺在预览图上对齐 LED 条/矩阵的物理形状。
Play 资产：`DMXPixelMappingRenderer` 采样颜色经 Runtime 写到 DMX 通道，输出端口送到真实灯带。
蓝图可用 `DMXPixelMappingBlueprintGraph` 启停映射；游戏模块只依赖 `DMXPixelMappingCore`/`Runtime`/`Renderer`。
`DMXPixelMappingEditor` 与 `DMXPixelMappingEditorWidgets` 仅 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `DMX Engine`, `DMX Protocol`, and `DMX Pixel Mapping` (`DMXPixelMappingRuntime` / `DMXPixelMappingRenderer`; editor `DMXPixelMappingEditor`).
Create a `DMX Pixel Mapping` asset and open its pixel-mapping editor (not the Material Editor).
Add a Renderer (scene capture, texture, or material output), then fixture groups bound to Patches, and lay cells over the preview to match the physical LED strip or matrix.
Play the asset so `DMXPixelMappingRenderer` samples color and Runtime writes DMX channels out the protocol ports to real pixels.
Start/stop mapping from Blueprint via `DMXPixelMappingBlueprintGraph`; game modules take `DMXPixelMappingCore`/`Runtime`/`Renderer` only.
Keep `DMXPixelMappingEditor` and `DMXPixelMappingEditorWidgets` on Editor targets.
note_cn: 把引擎画面采样成任意形状的 LED/灯具阵列 DMX，不是 nDisplay Light Card 桥。
note_en: Samples engine pixels onto arbitrary LED/fixture arrays as DMX, not the nDisplay Light Card bridge.

cn_steps: 启用 `DMX Protocol`（`DMXProtocol`、`DMXProtocolArtNet`、`DMXProtocolSACN`；编辑器 `DMXProtocolEditor`）。
打开 `Project Settings > Plugins > DMX`，添加 Input/Output Port：选 Art-Net 或 sACN，填网卡、Universe、单播/广播地址。
同一台机器上用 Wireshark 或灯光软件看 `DMXProtocolArtNet` / `DMXProtocolSACN` 是否在发 512 通道；防火墙要放行 UDP 6454（Art-Net）或 5568（sACN）。
蓝图通过 `DMXProtocolBlueprintGraph` 监听端口字节（原始 Universe），一般业务仍应走 `DMX Engine` 的属性层。
多网卡演播环境务必绑对 NIC，否则 DMX 会打到错误网段。
`DMXProtocolEditor` 只进 Editor；游戏包保留 Art-Net/sACN 运行时模块即可。
en_steps: Enable `DMX Protocol` (`DMXProtocol`, `DMXProtocolArtNet`, `DMXProtocolSACN`; editor `DMXProtocolEditor`).
Under `Project Settings > Plugins > DMX`, add Input/Output Ports: Art-Net or sACN, NIC, universe, unicast/broadcast.
Confirm `DMXProtocolArtNet` / `DMXProtocolSACN` emit 512-slot universes with Wireshark or a lighting app; allow UDP 6454 (Art-Net) or 5568 (sACN).
Blueprint can watch raw universe bytes via `DMXProtocolBlueprintGraph`; most shows should still use `DMX Engine` attributes.
Bind the correct NIC on multi-homed stages or DMX lands on the wrong subnet.
Keep `DMXProtocolEditor` on Editor targets; shipping needs the Art-Net/sACN runtime modules.
note_cn: 只实现 Art-Net/sACN 端口，不包含 Library 或灯具网格。
note_en: Art-Net/sACN ports only; no Library and no fixture meshes.

cn_steps: 启用 `DNACalib Plugin`（`DNACalibModule` + 第三方库 `DNACalibLib`）。它给 MetaHuman / RigLogic 的 `.dna` 做校准，不是可挂到骨骼网格的动画组件。
工具或编辑器模块 `Build.cs` 依赖 `DNACalibModule`，`#include` DNACalib 头，加载角色 `.dna`。
用校准 API 做关节重映射、LOD 裁剪、无用关节删除或行为缩放，再写出新的 DNA；这是离线/管线步骤，不是 AnimBP 节点。
把校准后的 DNA 交给 RigLogic / MetaHuman 角色导入链路，在编辑器里打开脸部绑定确认表情仍在。
`DNACalibLibTest` 仅用于自动化，不要写进游戏 `Build.cs` 或 Shipping。
运行时游戏一般只消费已经校准好的 DNA，不必在玩家进程里再跑一遍校准。
en_steps: Enable `DNACalib Plugin` (`DNACalibModule` plus `DNACalibLib`). It calibrates MetaHuman / RigLogic `.dna` files; it is not an Anim component you attach to a mesh.
Depend on `DNACalibModule` from a tool/editor `Build.cs`, include DNACalib headers, and load the character `.dna`.
Use the calibration API for joint remaps, LOD pruning, unused-joint removal, or behavior scaling, then write a new DNA. This is an offline pipeline step, not an AnimBP node.
Feed the calibrated DNA into RigLogic / MetaHuman import and open the face rig to confirm expressions still evaluate.
Keep `DNACalibLibTest` out of game `Build.cs` and shipping.
Cooked games normally consume already-calibrated DNA; do not run calibration inside the player process.
note_cn: MetaHuman DNA 校准库，给制作管线用，不是关卡里的动画修改器。
note_en: MetaHuman DNA calibration library for the authoring pipeline, not a level animation modifier.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental `Doodle`（`Doodle`、`DoodleSlate`、`DoodleEditor`、`DoodleMovieScene`、`DoodleSequencer`）并重启。
打开关卡 `Sequencer`，用 `DoodleSequencer` 提供的 Doodle 轨/工具在视口用 `DoodleSlate` 画笔做镜头批注（箭头、圈字），不是材质涂鸦，也不是 Control Rig。
笔画由 `DoodleMovieScene` 写成 Movie Scene section，随序列 scrub 显示/隐藏，可给导演或现场做画面指示。
播放序列确认批注跟镜头对齐；需要导出发片时把它当叠加层，不要指望它进游戏 HUD。
`DoodleEditor` / `DoodleTests` 不要进 Game Target；现场工具链可保留 Runtime + MovieScene 模块。
接口无官方描述且 Experimental，不要当镜头完成稿的永久资产格式。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Doodle` (`Doodle`, `DoodleSlate`, `DoodleEditor`, `DoodleMovieScene`, `DoodleSequencer`) and restart.
Open level `Sequencer` and use the Doodle track/tools from `DoodleSequencer` to draw shot notes (arrows, circles) in the viewport via `DoodleSlate` — not a paintable material and not Control Rig.
`DoodleMovieScene` stores strokes as Movie Scene sections that appear/hide while you scrub, for director or set callouts.
Play the sequence to confirm notes stay locked to the shot. Treat them as overlays for review, not as in-game HUD.
Keep `DoodleEditor` / `DoodleTests` off Game targets; the stage toolchain can keep Runtime + MovieScene.
Undocumented and Experimental; do not freeze it as the archival format for finished shots.
note_cn: Sequencer 视口批注/涂鸦轨，服务虚拟制片看片，不是运行时绘画玩法。
note_en: Sequencer viewport annotation tracks for VP reviews, not a gameplay painting system.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental `Draw Debug Library`（模块 `DrawDebugLibrary`），游戏模块 `Build.cs` 加上同名依赖。
C++ `#include` 该模块公共头，或在蓝图搜索 Draw Debug Library 函数（线、盒、球、胶囊、字符串），代替到处散落的 `DrawDebugHelpers`。
在 Actor `Tick` 或一次性事件里传入 World、位置、颜色、`Duration`；`Duration=0` 表示单帧。
PIE 打开 `Show > Developer > Debug Shapes`（或确保 `r.DebugSafeZone` / 调试绘制未被关），从摄像机看到形状。
Shipping 通常应编译剥离或用 `ENABLE_DRAW_DEBUG` 保护；不要把它当成运行时特效网格。
这不是 `Custom Mesh Component`，也不会生成可保存的静态网格。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Draw Debug Library` (module `DrawDebugLibrary`) and add it to the game `Build.cs`.
Include the module’s public headers, or call Draw Debug Library Blueprint nodes (line, box, sphere, capsule, string) instead of ad-hoc `DrawDebugHelpers`.
From `Tick` or a one-shot event, pass World, location, color, and `Duration` (`0` = one frame).
In PIE, enable `Show > Developer > Debug Shapes` (and do not disable debug drawing CVars) so the camera actually sees the shapes.
Strip or guard with `ENABLE_DRAW_DEBUG` for Shipping; this is not a gameplay VFX mesh.
Not `Custom Mesh Component`, and it does not author a savable static mesh.
note_cn: 实验性调试绘制函数库，只用于开发可视化，不是可渲染的游戏网格。
note_en: Experimental debug-draw helpers for development visualization, not a renderable game mesh.

cn_steps: 启用 `DTLS network packet handler`（模块 `DTLSHandlerComponent`）。它是 `PacketHandler` 管道组件，不能当 `UActorComponent` 加到 Actor。
在客户端与服务器的 `DefaultEngine.ini` 写 `[PacketHandlerComponents]`，`Components=DTLSHandlerComponent`（名称不要写成 AES 那两个 Handler）。
配置 DTLS 证书/密钥（引擎 DTLS 设置或部署时下发的 cert），保证 DS 与客户端是同一套身份材料。
用 dedicated server 联机进关，确认握手完成后复制包走 DTLS 加解密（比预共享 AES 更接近证书握手）。
两端 PacketHandler 列表必须一致，否则加密通道建不起来。
可进 Shipping；若只需要对称预共享密钥，应改用 `AESGCMHandlerComponent` 而不是误配 DTLS。
en_steps: Enable `DTLS network packet handler` (module `DTLSHandlerComponent`). It is a `PacketHandler` pipeline component, not a `UActorComponent`.
On both client and server `DefaultEngine.ini`, set `[PacketHandlerComponents]` `Components=DTLSHandlerComponent` (not the AES handler names).
Provision DTLS certificates/keys (engine DTLS settings or deployed certs) so DS and clients share the same identity material.
Join a dedicated server and confirm replication is DTLS-encrypted after handshake (certificate-style, unlike pre-shared AES).
PacketHandler lists must match on both ends or the encrypted channel will not come up.
Shippable; if you only want a pre-shared symmetric key, use `AESGCMHandlerComponent` instead of misconfiguring DTLS.
note_cn: 基于 DTLS 的包加密 Handler，需要证书材料；与 AES/AES-GCM Handler 互不替换名字。
note_en: DTLS packet encryption that needs certificates; not interchangeable with the AES/AES-GCM handler names.

cn_steps: 启用开发者插件 `Dump GPU Services`（模块 `DumpGPUServices`）。它给控制台命令 `DumpGPU` 提供自动上传，不是后期处理效果。
在 `DefaultEngine.ini` 或项目的 DumpGPU 服务配置里填写上传端点/令牌（插件注册的 upload service）。
复现渲染问题后，在控制台执行 `DumpGPU`（可带帧数/路径参数），本地会写出 GPU 转储。
确认 `DumpGPUServices` 把转储自动传到配置的服务，而不是只停在工程 Saved 目录。
这是制作/调试管线，不要写进 Game Target，也不要在 Shipping 包保留上传令牌。
不要在 Post Process Volume 或 Show Flag 里找它——没有画面开关。
en_steps: Enable the developer plugin `Dump GPU Services` (module `DumpGPUServices`). It auto-uploads `DumpGPU` captures; it is not a post-process effect.
Set the upload endpoint/token in `DefaultEngine.ini` or the plugin’s DumpGPU service config.
After reproducing a rendering bug, run `DumpGPU` in the console (optional frame/path args) to write a local GPU dump.
Confirm `DumpGPUServices` uploads that dump to the configured service instead of leaving it only under Saved.
Authoring/debug only: keep it off Game targets and never ship upload tokens.
There is no Post Process Volume or Show Flag for this plugin.
note_cn: DumpGPU 的自动上传服务，编辑器/开发机使用，不进游戏运行时画面。
note_en: Automatic upload service for DumpGPU; editor/dev machines only, not a runtime picture setting.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental `Dynamic Wind`（`DynamicWind` + `DynamicWindEditor`）。它只作用于 **Nanite 植被**，普通 Foliage 顶点风或 `WindDirectionalSource` 不是同一条路。
关卡里的树木/草必须开 Nanite；在 Foliage Type 或静态网格上确认 Nanite 已启用。
放置/配置 Dynamic Wind 源（插件提供的风场 Actor/设置），用 `DynamicWindEditor` 在视口看风场，调节方向、强度、阵风。
PIE 绕着 Nanite 树冠检查叶片位移；关闭 Nanite 后风效应应消失，以此确认没有走旧的顶点动画风。
游戏模块只依赖 `DynamicWind`；`DynamicWindEditor` 仅 Editor Target。
标记为 extremely experimental，不要作为 Shipping 植被方案的唯一依赖。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Dynamic Wind` (`DynamicWind` + `DynamicWindEditor`). It targets **Nanite foliage** only, not classic foliage vertex wind or `WindDirectionalSource`.
Enable Nanite on the trees/grass (Foliage Type or static mesh).
Place/configure the Dynamic Wind source (wind-field actor/settings) and use `DynamicWindEditor` in the viewport to tune direction, strength, and gusts.
In PIE, orbit Nanite canopies to see leaf motion; disable Nanite and the effect should vanish, proving you are not on the old vertex-wind path.
Game modules depend on `DynamicWind` only; `DynamicWindEditor` stays on Editor targets.
Marked extremely experimental; do not make it the sole shipping foliage-wind solution.
note_cn: Nanite 树叶的实验动态风，和传统 WindDirectionalSource 不是同一套系统。
note_en: Experimental Nanite-foliage wind; not the same system as WindDirectionalSource.
